## Core research question
Can explicit structural habits used in engineering and computer science help reverse engineer living, cognitive and social systems, and exactly where does that transfer succeed, weaken, or fail?

## Canonical reasoning protocol
DEFINE → FRAME → OBSERVE → MAP → MODELS → PREDICT → TEST → UPDATE → ACT → LEARN AND STOP

## Interpretation rules
Evidence status and transfer status are separate. Strong evidence in one domain does not automatically justify transfer into another. The ontology is bounded to this edition; it is not presented as an exhaustive ontology of life or reality. Application mappings and product concepts are possibilities to test, not claims of feasibility, demand or guaranteed outcomes.

## Paid/public boundary
The public repository exposes the sales page, methodology and sample. The complete Buyer Edition remains private and is delivered after verified purchase.
